title: Calling an MCP server directly and through MCPToolset
description: This script inspects and calls calendar_server.py directly with a FastMCP Client, then attaches the same server to a Pydantic AI Agent with MCPToolset.

steps.description: inspect_server() starts calendar_server.py over stdio, lists its tools and schemas, calls days_until with a valid date, and shows that the server rejects 'next Tuesday'.
Passing toolsets=[MCPToolset(Path('calendar_server.py'))] gives the Agent access to the server's tools during agent.run_sync.
